set.body: Objective: close the measured JVM public-API gap without changing ownership, layout, dtype, or fixed block-pairwise reduction semantics. Baseline is the parity-gated 12-case compute geomean of 0.141x NumPy at side 256. Release target after a quiet JDK 21 two-size rerun: geomean at least 0.50x, no compute case below 0.25x, and no same-host regression above 10 percent; stretch target is geomean 0.70x with no case below 0.50x. Scalar indexing and zero-copy view creation are reported but excluded from the compute geomean. Order: control baselines, copy materialization, elementwise loop dispatch, exact-schedule reductions, closeout gate. Defer Vector API, native dependencies, parallelism, and public fast-math modes until monomorphic scalar kernels establish the remaining gap.
set.title: Close Ravel JVM performance gap to NumPy
